lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with specific clusters appearing as local maxima in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a localized grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels above a shadow-defined lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left quadrant displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance blobs concentrated along its leading edge and dorsal surface.
